Definition: resemblance; concretely, model, shape; adverbially, like
BiblicalUsage: This word means likeness or resemblance, the shape a thing bears to something else. It carries the weight of Genesis, where man is made in the likeness of God, and of Ezekiel, where the living creatures and the throne bear a likeness no eye can fully take in.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe likeness is the thread that ties creation to the Creator. We are made to resemble Him, and when sin distorts that likeness, redemption is God restoring His own image in us.
